pattern.description: The section headline and the summary list underneath it lift upward together and fade out (the view scrolls down the page). The transcript view (tab bar plus chat bubbles) fades in, rising slightly, into the space they leave.
pattern.why_premium: One continuous upward motion carries the eye from the section title to the content it introduces, with no hard cut. The overlap of the fade-out and fade-in keeps the white canvas steady, so the change feels like scrolling one page and not like a scene change.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to(['.headline','.summaryList'], {y: -260, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.in'}); tl.fromTo(['.tabs','.bubble'], {y: 40, opacity: 0}, {y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power3.out', stagger: 0.03}, '-=0.2'); highlighted spans keep their gradient colour (static).
build_hint.remotion: Outgoing: translateY = interpolate(frame, [0, 15], [0, -260], {easing: Easing.in(Easing.quad)}) and opacity 1 to 0. Incoming: spring({frame: frame - 9 - i, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 120}}) drives translateY 40 to 0 and opacity 0 to 1 for the tabs and each bubble i.

notes: camera.move is tilt_down, but this looks like a scroll of the content (it moves up) mixed with a crossfade, not a true camera move. The headline is not on the end frame, so it uses manual_box. b01 is a union box standing in for the outgoing list region. The bubble stagger is hard to see at this sampling and may really be one block fade.
